tools.name: calculate_loan
tools.description: Use this when the user wants a mortgage calculator, loan calculator, or amortization calculator result: the monthly (or biweekly/weekly) payment, an amortization schedule or table, total interest, payoff date, a mortgage calculator with extra payments or for paying off early, or a full PITI payment

tools.name: compare_loans
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to compare 2 to 4 loan or mortgage options side by side, such as 15-year vs 30-year, different interest rates, paying discount points, or a mortgage calculator for refinance options. Shared values (loan amount, rate, term) go at the top level and each scenario overrides
